notifications.name: AC DC ADAPTOR Switching Adapter
notifications.danger: Inside the device, some electrical parts (such as components or circuits) are not sufficiently distant from each other. Moreover, the device is missing one of the safety capacitors to prevent electricity leakage between hazardous and accessible parts. Additionally, the cable connecting the device to the electrical socket has a different number of pins between the plug (wall side) and the connector (device side). This may cause a poor connection and increase the risk of overheating or an electric shock. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Low Voltage Directive.

notifications.name: 200 L
notifications.danger: The structure of the socket allows single-pole insertion of plugs and the protection surface of the plug's face is insufficient. Moreover, the wires can be pulled or twisted out of their terminals and the single-layer insulation is insufficient for a Class II appliance, which could lead to exposed live parts. Finally, the insulation does not ensure adequate separation from live (active) parts during the lifetime of the luminaire. The user could touch accessible live parts and receive an electric shock. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Low Voltage Directive nor with the European standards EN 60598-1 and EN 60598-2.

notifications.name: Boxer NG
notifications.danger: Due to a mistranslation of the configuration data between two production systems, the vehicle’s body control module (BCM) may not be correctly configured to detect indicator light failures. If an indicator bulb fails, the BCM may not detect the fault and the warning signal may not illuminate, reducing communication with other road users and increasing the risk of an accident. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
